2610.02375.title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
2610.02375.paper_summary: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.
2610.02375.paper_summary_zh: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) 報告可能包含來自單次 3D 掃描的數十項特定牙齒的解剖和空間發現。<lb/>從有限的臨床數據生成這類報告是具有挑戰性的，因為常規報告可能未能全面記錄影像發現，而未提及可能反映的是缺失或未報告。<lb/>我們提出了 EviDent-CBCT，一個針對這種不完整監督設計的證據瓶頸框架。<lb/>一個具解剖學意識的網絡將每個 CBCT 掃描映射到牙齒層級、全局和牙齒-IAC 證據的離散記錄。<lb/>一個牙科邏輯一致性投影在確定性渲染器之前調和不兼容的證據，而一個圖像盲的本地語言模型僅使用這個記錄生成報告。<lb/>對於牙齒層級證據，可靠性意識的訓練將合格的未提及作為減重負樣本，而未報告的全局和牙齒-IAC 標籤仍然未知。<lb/>一個金屬敏感的輸入通道保留了來自牙科材料的強度線索。<lb/>在三次驗證運行中，EviDent-CBCT 達到了 $0.666\pm0.006$ 合併證據集-F1 和 $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental 邏輯-F1，而最強的控制直接基準為 $0.371\pm0.018$。<lb/>在 ODIN 2026 挑戰中，它在自動評估中排名第二，在盲測臨床 Arena 比較中排名第三。<lb/>這些結果支持離散證據記錄作為 CBCT 報告生成的有效且可審計的介面。
